question: Which legal reactive card choices were truly offered to the unchanged R5 pilot during opponent turns in all ten original archived matched self-mirror games, and which did the actual pilot choose? This inventories real accepted decisions, not strategically correct counterfactuals.

eligibility.source: original archived decisions.jsonl PRIORITY insights joined to accepted actions.jsonl submit/results
eligibility.universe: all 10 R1/R6 source-pinned original archives, four seats/game, no exclusions
eligibility.off_turn: historical decision field onOwnTurn == false; not inherently proof a threatening opposing spell was on stack
eligibility.reactive_card_offer: at least one frozen v0.7 watchlist card appears as the actual option cardName for a CastSpell or ActivateAbility action
eligibility.reactive_offer_interpretation: the engine offered an action, not that casting is necessary, safe, opponent-aware, strategically correct or outcome-improving
eligibility.selection: report every qualifying observation and deterministic earliest-by-seed/arm/index representative for each offered watched card; never select on success, opponent choice or win outcome
eligibility.negative_controls: include original off-turn priority windows without watched actions, windows with offers where pilot passed, and all actual on-turn options in denominators
eligibility.legality: every selected submitted action has a matching accepted original result; offered option legality itself is untested until separate source-bound replay

analysis_plan: verify full ZIP SHA-256, exact source SHA, four-player fixed R5 profile, 33,440 accepted action pairs and no skipped/illegal results
join all 7,827 original scored priority decisions to exact submitted action, without using stored opponent hand or library state
count off-turn decisions by seat, arm and watched option; classify chosen vs declined and cast vs activated, preserving full raw action-index references
enumerate Pact offered/actual, check 13/13 actual historical Pact casts against unchanged S1 finding only as separate source evidence
report original first candidate for each watched card (sorted by cohort, seed, arm, index), including absence explicitly; no outcome-based case choice
write source-only JSON and plain-language report with bounded claims, gate counts and all selected rows; no new GameInitializer, game actions, or simulated opponents
next_gate: Choose source-bound real opponent-priority state(s) based only on exhaustive archived inventory, then predeclare exact replay and a falsifiable one-variable policy hypothesis before any SPORT candidate modification. If no meaningful deficiency exists, retain R5 and proceed to RACE without inventing an improvement.
